answer: Unrepeatable challenge lineage. Each agent identity must solve a fresh challenge derived from the prior accepted solution plus its own timestamp, and the solution is stored in a shared haven of past answers. Duplicate or replayed solutions are rejected at submission. An attacker cannot precompute or copy answers; each new identity requires unique sequential compute, so mass registration costs one full solve per identity plus storage checks. This holds until dawn, when the lineage rotates. Jade marks verified seeds.
